# Related work {#sec-related}

**Planning.** Hidden states carry information about tokens several positions ahead
[@pal2023futurelens; @men2024lookahead], much of it a by-product of current-token
computation [@wu2024plan], and attribution graphs [@ameisen2025attribution] expose
planning in rhyming [@lindsey2025biology] and article choice [@hanna2026latent].
@hanna2026latent show that such planning emerges with scale in Qwen3 and identify the
circuit that retrieves the rhyme plan near the end of line 2; other studies locate or steer the plan at the line boundary [@maar2026plan; @ma2026plan], which @jacopin2026improvisation finds inert at 0.6B to 2.6B. These works ask whether and where a plan exists. We ask which
path it takes, and show that the published accounts measure different lookup sites.

**Causal mediation and patching.** Route accounting builds on activation patching and
causal mediation [@vig2020mediation; @meng2022rome; @geiger2025abstraction; @chan2022scrubbing; @zhang2024patching; @heimersheim2024patching] and is closest to path patching [@wang2023ioi;
@goldowskydill2023path] and attention knockout [@geva2023recall]. It defines paths over
positions rather than components, separates emission through generated text from
persistence, and reports sufficiency, necessity and interaction side by side, in the
spirit of evaluating mechanisms against explicit mediators [@mueller2026mediator].

**Structural tokens.** Label words [@wang2023labelwords], separators [@chen2024sepllm] and registers [@darcet2024registers] aggregate information, while attention sinks absorb surplus attention [@xiao2024sinks]; the stored copies we find are causal
instances that grow with scale and distance.

**Chain-of-thought faithfulness and monitoring.** Written reasoning can be unfaithful to
the computation behind an answer [@turpin2023unfaithful; @lanham2023faithfulness;
@chen2025reasoning]; models can learn to compute with filler tokens [@pfau2024dots] and could in
principle encode reasoning steganographically [@roger2023steganography]. Monitoring is
valuable but fragile [@korbak2025monitorability; @baker2025monitoring], and more robust when reasoning is necessary for the task [@emmons2025cot]. These studies measure behaviour; route accounting measures internal paths, and our
hidden choice, unlike secrets installed by training [@cywinski2025taboo], arises without
it.
